Posterior predictive checks using rootograms for occARU_fit objects

pp_check.occARU_fit.Rd

Perform visual posterior predictive checks using rootograms using the bayesplot package.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'occARU_fit'
pp_check(
  object,
  level = c("Q", "y"),
  group = c("species", "region", "season"),
  ndraws = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted model object from occARU().

level

Character. One of "Q" or "y". If "Q" (default), uses the aggregated counts per site and species as data. If "y", uses the raw (survey-level) counts as input.

group

Character. Whether to group by "species" (default), "region", or "season".

ndraws

Positive integer. Number of draws to use. If NULL (default), uses all draws.

...

Additional arguments to be passed to bayesplot::ppc_rootogram_grouped().

Value

A ggplot object with posterior predictive rootograms faceted by species which can be modified using the ggplot2 package.
